recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of a young male artist against a clean white background, featuring large, distressed block lettering that passes behind the subject's head and a secondary handwritten subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject overlaps the primary display typography to create depth
High contrast between the dark clothing and the stark white background
Juxtaposition of rigid, weathered block type with casual, organic handwriting
Textural harmony between the distressed font and the graphic on the subject's shirt

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, waist-up, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large blue block lettering.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves outward to the large name text, then drops to the handwritten subtitle on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the subject and text, creating a clean, modern feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the background and the foreground elements.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight with uniform stroke thickness
Eroded or 'stamped' texture applied to the fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are partially obscured by the subject's head to integrate the figure into the design

composition.scale: Large, spanning the width of the frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Industrial block type paired with casual personal handwriting to suggest a mix of commercial production and personal artistry.

avoid: Script fonts that look too formal or calligraphic

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for the display text.
Captures the weathered, stamped aesthetic without needing manual distressing.
Matches the informal, personal tone of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key studio portrait of a young man with medium-length dark hair, wearing a dark graphic t-shirt and jeans, centered against a pure white background. The lighting should be soft but directional, creating subtle shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large uppercase block text in navy blue across the top third, applying a heavy grunge/distressed texture to the letters. Mask the text so it appears to pass behind the subject's head. Add a small, handwritten subtitle in the same navy blue to the right side, tilted slightly upward.

verificationChecks: Does the subject overlap the main text?
Is the subtitle in a casual handwritten style?

adjustableVariables: Color of the typography (within the navy/cool spectrum)
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Sense of depth through text layering

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text texture doesn't look like a generic filter.
Ensure the masking around the subject's hair is natural.
Verify the handwritten text looks organic and not like a repetitive font.
Confirm the navy blue is consistent across all graphic elements.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered high-key portrait with oversized, weathered sans-serif display type layered behind the subject, accented by a small, tilted handwritten note for a classic 2000s indie-rock aesthetic.
